setlist_extra.title: Stuck Inside Of Mobile, With the Memphis Blues Again

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **They Love Each Other** (1 review): Reviewer calls They Love Each Other a rare kickdown that made up for a slow first set [14]
- **Looks Like Rain** (1 review): Reviewer calls it the best Looks Like Rain they've heard, with deep feeling and a tight band [13]
- **Playin' in the Band** (1 review): Reviewer notes an extra long Playin' and praises the jam into space [11]
- **Memphis Blues** (1 review): Memphis Blues is also cited as a rare kickdown that compensated for a slow first set [14]

## The recordings

- **gd1992-05-29.sbd.ladner-hinko.35295.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 20 songs; 162 min [1]. Said about its sound: Band members comment on the mix throughout; hi-hat cymbals are oddly prominent at times [1]
- **gd1992-05-29.josephsonc-640.chuckm.116446.flac16**: audience recording; 20 songs; 168 min [2]. Said about its sound: Strong wind blasts get through the windscreens, especially near the end [2]
- **gd1992-05-29.fob.schoeps.84998.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 21 songs; 164 min; rated 4.5/5 by 4 [3]. Said about its sound: No known flaws, apart from typical first-song band-side imperfections in Half-Step [3]
- **gd92-05-29.sbd.ladner.21320.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 19 songs; 162 min; rated 4.06/5 by 16 [4]. Said about its sound: Outstanding sound quality; vocals a bit rough in places; Bobby is audible through the PA when requesting mix changes; Recording picks up cues between band members; sound quality called excellent [11][21]

## Around the show

- Wind, rain and lightning striking in the distance gave an eerie atmosphere; PA problems didn't deter the band [10]
- Thunder was hard to attribute, coming from both the Looks Like Rain song and the real weather [10]
- Extreme heat; sprinklers were set up around the bowl to keep people from passing out [15]
- Thunder, cooling wind and rain from Mt. Charleston arrived as Bob sang Looks Like Rain [15]
- Storm approached across the desert, then clouds parted and went around the stadium, leaving blue sky overhead [16]
- Reviewer hitchhiked from downtown Vegas, stood left of center near the stage in blazing, dry desert heat [18]
- Wind, rain and lightning hit; a nearby lightning strike draws an audible crowd "Whoa!" during a quiet passage [3]
- Reviewer says the band had a good vibe at the Silver Bowl over many years, and this show fits that [12]
- Described as the first night of a three-day Las Vegas run [18]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1992-05-29.sbd.ladner-hinko.35295.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by C. Ladner; source: SBD > DAT [1]. Also: Not a monitor mix; band is audible because they forgot to switch channels, so everything came through the PA [1]
- **gd1992-05-29.josephsonc-640.chuckm.116446.flac16**: taped by Chuck Miller; transferred by Chuck Miller; source: Source (AUD): Josephson C-640 w/ KA-20 (cardioid) capsules > 5532 differential pre-amp (+21db) > Sony WMD-6C (Dolby C encoded); Microphone configuration: TS,… [2]. Also: Recorded, processed and distributed by Chuck Miller; first digital release of this source [2]
- **gd1992-05-29.fob.schoeps.84998.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Tony, Redondo Dave, and other contributors*; transferred by Scott Swayne; source: FOB Schoeps MK4s -> Reutelhuber-> sv255 -> (clone) Teac DA-p20 [3]. Also: Lineage info updated and taper names corrected from the original seed [3]
- **gd92-05-29.sbd.ladner.21320.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [4]. Also: Full DAT transfer with no flips or gaps [11]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Fred Strame Grateful Dead: [1992-05-29 Sam Boyd Silver Bowl, U.N.L.V., Las Vegas, NV, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1992-05-29-sam-boyd-silver-bowl-u-n-l-v-las-vegas-nv-usa/) [23]
- Fan art by sandcastlesandglasscamels.blogspot.com: [5-29,30, 31-92 Sam Boyd Silver Bowl, U.N.L.V., Las Vegas, NV](https://sandcastlesandglasscamels.blogspot.com/2010/06/5-2930-31-92-sam-boyd-silver-bowl-unlv.html) [24]
- Fan art by www.gdao.org: [Grateful Dead, The Steve Miller Band. May 29-31, 1992, Silver Bowl, Las Vegas · Grateful Dead Archive Online · Grateful ](https://www.gdao.org/items/show/377122) [25]
- Poster by Fred Strame Grateful Dead: [1992-05-29 Sam Boyd Silver Bowl, U.N.L.V., Las Vegas, NV, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1992-05-29-sam-boyd-silver-bowl-u-n-l-v-las-vegas-nv-usa/) [26]
